title: Formation names: Reinstate a name the client rejected
text: A name the client rejected, or rejected by mistake, could never be brought back. The Formation names panel now has a Reinstate button, with a confirmation, on names marked Client rejected. It reserves the name again and sends the client a fresh approval card, cancelling any outdated new-names request.
points: Names refused by the state, or already filed, stay blocked.
Adding a name that was already used still follows the same duplicate rule as before.
